texts.text: Real NASA data · the May 2024 solar storm
Our rocket broke on the trip. Build a new one to fly to Mars!
A flare flashed on the Sun.
Forecast: CALM to RISING. Shield: 0–1 batteries.
Deep space has no shield. Watch the radiation!
No magnetic shield out here. A CME is coming!
Forecast: RISING to EXTREME. Shield: 1–3 batteries.
Build a whole base in 8 days!
Give batteries to a building site to build it.
Mars nights are freezing. Build the Heating early!
Welcome to Mars! A very cold night is coming.

endTexts.text: Real NASA storm data from May 2024. Batteries, oxygen and the rocket are game rules.
